\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 212-213 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R216-first-pass-words-from-chapters-212-213}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an electrician and a tailor.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a lid, a cardboard box, a bag, a clay jar, a small tea glass
  \item nail clippers, a stool, a wall niche, a circle, a dot
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A lid? (\textbf{\fa{درپوش}}, \emph{darpush}.) A cardboard box? (\textbf{\fa{کارتن}}, \emph{kârton}.) A bag? (\textbf{\fa{کیسه}}, \emph{kise}.) A clay jar? (\textbf{\fa{کوزه}}, \emph{kuze}.) A small tea glass? (\textbf{\fa{استکان}}, \emph{estekân}.) Nail clippers? (\textbf{\fa{ناخنگیر}}, \emph{nâkhongir}.) A stool? (\textbf{\fa{چهارپایه}}, \emph{chahârpâye}.) A wall niche? (\textbf{\fa{طاقچه}}, \emph{tâqche}.) A circle? (\textbf{\fa{دایره}}, \emph{dâyere}.) A dot? (\textbf{\fa{نقطه}}, \emph{noqte}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 214-216 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R216-second-pass-words-from-chapters-214-216}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item experience, an employer, an employee, a colleague, a manager
  \item a mark, homework, a journalist, an actor, a singer
  \item a workshop, a carpenter, a plumber, an electrician, a tailor
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Experience? (\textbf{\fa{تجربه}}, \emph{tajrobe}.) An employer? (\textbf{\fa{کارفرما}}, \emph{kârfarmâ}.) An employee? (\textbf{\fa{کارمند}}, \emph{kârmand}.) A colleague? (\textbf{\fa{همکار}}, \emph{hamkâr}.) A manager? (\textbf{\fa{مدیر}}, \emph{modir}.) A mark? (\textbf{\fa{نمره}}, \emph{nomre}.) Homework? (\textbf{\fa{مشق}}, \emph{mashq}.) A journalist? (\textbf{\fa{خبرنگار}}, \emph{khabarnegâr}.) An actor? (\textbf{\fa{بازیگر}}, \emph{bâzigar}.) A singer? (\textbf{\fa{خواننده}}, \emph{khânande}.) A workshop? (\textbf{\fa{کارگاه}}, \emph{kârgâh}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\fa{نجار}}, \emph{najjâr}.) A plumber? (\textbf{\fa{لوله} \fa{کش}}, \emph{lulekesh}.) An electrician? (\textbf{\fa{برقکار}}, \emph{barqkâr}.) A tailor? (\textbf{\fa{خیاط}}, \emph{khayyât}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
